correctness.rationale: The capacity-allocation equivalence reduces every parameter to a superlevel set of the sum of the largest \(s\) barycentric coordinates. This function is PL on the barycentric subdivision; a direct good-vertex projection gives a global strong deformation retraction onto each simplex skeleton. Augmented chain exactness and the connectivity of skeleta prove the integral wedge ranks and inclusion barcodes. The last void is an unclipped scaled polar hypersimplex; the braid-chamber basis, Gram determinant \(1/n\), exact ray product, and extreme coordinate bound verify the coefficient and its exact parameter interval. Exact rational tests passed 12,615 checks; a separate convex-hull algorithm passed 9 volume checks. Finite computations are supplementary.
